title: Dyson Sphere
description: Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

puzzle.goal: A thin closed shell of radius r surrounds a star and absorbs all of its light. In equilibrium the shell radiates the star's whole luminosity from its outer surface only, as a black body at uniform temperature T. Write that luminosity as the radiated flux integrated over the shell in spherical coordinates.
puzzle.name: Radiative equilibrium of a closed shell (Stefan–Boltzmann)
puzzle.form: int ( 0 , π , int ( 0 , 2 * π , σ * T ^ 4 * r ^ 2 * sin ( θ ) , φ ) , θ )
puzzle.ask: The integral is 4πr²σT⁴. Find the equilibrium temperature (K) of a shell at r = @{r} AU around a star of L = @{L} solar luminosities.

vars.L: stellar luminosity (in the numeric step: in solar luminosities)
vars.\u03c3: radiation constant of a black body
vars.r: shell radius (in the numeric step: in AU)

puzzle.method: Each area element r² sin θ dθ dφ emits σT⁴; integrate over the full sphere and set the total equal to the luminosity, then solve for T.
